image.build_notes: Built from PR #73 commit c772d6572a15f0f21b10eadc9327947b2225cea2 on the isolated bench daemon with the legacy builder (DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0, --network host). VLLM_REPOSITORY was overridden to the local git daemon at git://127.0.0.1:9418/vllm-hist.git. The build fetched the content-locked source archive, copied sanitized Base history with directory-qualified .git paths, and passed the repository's image-check.
